note: Phase 10A Section 12: expected KV storage size from ggml's real block formats (ggml-common.h, pinned llama.cpp commit c0bc8591), compared to observed allocation from cpu_matrix_135m.jsonl / vulkan_matrix_135m.jsonl / second_model_360m.jsonl.

Q8_0.struct_layout: ggml_half d (2 bytes scale) + int8_t qs[32] (32 bytes quants)

Q4_0.struct_layout: ggml_half d (2 bytes scale) + uint8_t qs[16] (16 bytes packed nibbles)

consistency: EXACT MATCH to 4 significant figures at every measured context size (512/1024/2048/4096/8192/16384) and on both tested models. Q4_0's real 4.5-bit-per-element block format (not a naive '4 bits = 1/4 the memory' assumption) fully accounts for the observed allocation -- there is no discrepancy, hidden overhead, or unaccounted metadata in the real allocation vs the block-format-derived expectation.
explicit_caveat: 4-bit quantization is NOT exactly 25% (1/4) of F16's 16 bits, because Q4_0 carries a 16-bit fp16 scale per 32-element block (2 bytes / 32 elements = 0.5 bits/element of overhead) on top of the 4 raw quant bits -- true storage is 4.5 bits/element = 28.125% of F16, not 25%. This is exactly what was observed.
